proposals.premise: Because members often know their task but not the tool name, organize borrowing around jobs, then explain suitable tools, constraints, and availability in plain language.
proposals.opening: Desktop first shows a task prompt beside current availability and collection hours; phone stacks the prompt above the same status summary.
proposals.move: Choose a task from the first control. Matching items appear below, with eligibility, three-day borrowing, and Tuesday or Saturday collection windows; an available item can be requested there.
proposals.tradeoff: Beginners gain confident guidance, but experienced members take an extra step to reach a named tool.

proposals.premise: Because stock and restrictions determine what can actually be borrowed, lead with an honest inventory while adding task-based suitability cues to each item.
proposals.opening: Desktop first shows tool cards beside a pickup panel; phone shows the cards first, followed by collection hours. Two irons, Thursday’s thermal-camera return, and the supervised-bench multimeter share the view.
proposals.move: Select Request on an available card. An inline panel confirms suitability, induction when choosing an iron, and an eligible Tuesday or Saturday collection window; the damaged multimeter has no loan control.
proposals.tradeoff: Availability is immediately scannable, but members unfamiliar with tool names may compare more cards.
